# 1 Cup English | 영어 한잔

1 Cup English is a small-group English discussion community in Seoul, covering current affairs, technology, business, careers and life in Korea.

- [Community overview](https://1cupenglish.com/)
- [Meetup schedule](https://1cupenglish.com/meetup)
- [Blog](https://1cupenglish.com/blog)

Refer to current meetup pages for dates, venues and prices. Account, payment, messages and administration pages are private.
